versions.content: Upon request by the Dcm, the Dem shall repond with the number of TIDs per requested OBDMID using the API Dem_DcmGetNumTIDsOfOBDMID . This value can be used by the Dcm to iteratively request for the DTR data per OBDMID / TID-index whereas the TID-index loops from 0 to number-of-TIDs minus one.
